data.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Andros' meaning 'man' and 'Dios' meaning 'god'. A name for a man who is deeply devoted to God. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andrien usually hope their child will grow to embody man of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
